units.source_text: 笔直的长长的市街，很像当年旅馆区的街道。

en.t: The straight, long town street looked very much like the streets of the old inn district.

units.source_text: 这大概是从温泉乡直通过来的一条旧街吧。

en.t: This was probably an old street that ran straight through from the hot-spring village.

units.source_text: 木板葺的屋顶上的横木条和铺石，同温泉乡也没有什么不同。

en.t: The crosspieces on the wood-shingled roofs and the paving stones were no different from those in the hot-spring village.
